set.body: ThreeJsRuntime.dispose() disposes bundles and calls renderer.dispose() but never forces context loss, so disposed canvases count against the browser's live-WebGL budget until GC. Neuropublish measured eviction of older contexts after 24 mount/unmount cycles and now forces WEBGL_lose_context itself (neuropublish/modules/viewer-laminar SurfaceHost). Do it in dispose(): after renderer.dispose(), getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')?.loseContext(); set contextState accordingly. Acceptance: browser check that 24 create/dispose cycles keep a sentinel runtime Available.
set.title: ThreeJsRuntime.dispose() should force WebGL context loss
